source: 734 My Weapon
target: 734 Telum Meum

source: Lumian stood at the quarry cave’s exit, wanting to work with Mr. K to take on Perle, but unsure of how to proceed.
target: Lumian ad exitum speluncae fodinarum stetit, cupiens cum Domino K laborare ut Perlem oppugnaret, sed nesciebat quo modo procedendum esset.

source: Past experience had shown him that without godhood, any action against an Overseer would only come back to haunt him, without affecting the demigod at all.
target: Experientia praeterita eum docuit quod, sine divinitate, omnis actio contra Supervisorem tantum ad eum rediret ut eum vexaret, nec quidem semideum attineret.

source: With his golden mask removed, Lumian could only remain in place, considering what items he possessed that might be useful and effective.
target: Cum larva aurea exlata esset, Lumian solum in loco manere potuit, considerans quae instrumenta haberet quae utilis atque efficax esse possent.

source: He was left with no option but to watch the fight between Mr. K and Perle unfold as a mere spectator.
target: Nulla alia ei remansit nisi pugnam inter Dominum K et Perlem tamquam spectator videre.

source: At the same time, he scanned the area, looking for a way to utterly destroy the existing mirror world.
target: Simul circumspiciens, regionem perlustrare conabatur, qua viam inveniendi mundum speculi iam existentem omnino delere posset.

source: Anthony kept his posture and continued drawing on the blank painting album, which was missing a page.
target: Antonius statum suum retinuit et in album picturae vacuo, cui pagina defesset, delineare pergebat.

source: His current subject was to be Madam Magician.
target: Subiectum eius hodiernum erat Domina Maga.

source: As he observed Mr. K’s movements and listened to each slash, Lumian sensed a slight corruption creeping into his mind.
target: Dum motus Domini K contemplabat et singulos ictus auscultabat, Lumian levem corruptionem in animum suum subire sensit.

source: It surprised him that Mr. K could hold the Overseer at bay to some degree, unafraid of her accusations and armed with a means to harm her.
target: Eum mirum fuit quod Dominus K, sine timore accusationum eius et armatus instrumento nocendi, aliquam vim contra Supervisorem retinere potuisset.

source: Lumian silently hoped that even if Mr. K couldn’t defeat Perle, he would at least be able to drive her off.
target: Lumian tacite sperabat, etiam si Dominus K Perlem vincere non posset, saltem eam repellere valere.

source: Mustering strength from his waist and core, Mr. K swung his upper body as he descended, bringing the dark broadsword down on Overseer Perle’s head for the third time.
target: Virtutem ex lumbis et corde colligens, Dominus K, corpus superius movens et descendens, gladio nigro super caput Supervisori Perle tertiam ictum intulit.

source: Perle remained motionless, not using any Mirror Traversal-like ability to evade, nor rolling to the side.
target: Perle immota manebat, neque ullo ingenio speculi itineris utens ad effugiendum, neque se ad latus volvens.

source: She stood firm beside the jutting rock, her body turning pitch‑black and dissolving into a constantly dissipating shadow.
target: Firmiter iuxta saxum prominens stabat, corpusque eius in atrum nitidum vertens atque in umbram constanter evanescentem dissolvitur.

source: The dark, enigmatic broadsword plunged down abruptly, silently cleaving the shadows in two.
target: Gladius obscurus, arcanus, subito deorsum labens, tacite umbras in duas dividens.

source: The shadows rapidly encircled the protruding rock, perpetually moving and merging once again.
target: Umbræ celeriter saxum eminens circumcircuere, perpetuo movebantur et rursus confluentes erant.

source: They writhed, striving to reassemble Overseer Perle’s form.
target: Illae contorquebantur, conantes formam Supervisōris Perle recomponere.

source: Where the Sword of Darkness had cut through, the shadows struggled to form proper connections, barely managing to stack together into a humanoid shape riddled with cracks and misaligned parts.
target: Ubi Gladius Obscuritatis incidit, umbræ nexus idoneos formare studebant, vix convenientes in formam humanam aggregari, fissuris atque partibus disordinatis infestatam.

source: Mr. K sprang up, ready to swing the dark broadsword gripped in the gaping crack of his mouth.
target: Dominus K subsiluit, paratus gladium obscurum, quod in fovea oris eius latebat, agitare.

source: Suddenly, his body shrank rapidly, the cold black armor encasing him vanishing.
target: Subito, corpus eius celeriter contraxit, et lorica nigra frigida, quae eum circumferebat, evanuit.

source: He reverted to his original form, dressed in a black hood and matching robe.
target: Rediit ad formam suam primigeniam, indutus cucullo nigro et veste congruente.

source: The precariously assembled shadow gradually shed its black color, revealing human skin and a vivid red dress inch by inch.
target: Umbra, instabili modo composita, paulatim colorem nigrum dimittere coepit, patefacens cutem humanam atque vestem rubram vivam singulis graduibus.

source: In the shadowy cathedral at an undisclosed location, the mercury giant serpent phantom hanging in midair slowly faded away.
target: In cathedrale umbratā, loco ignoto, phantasma serpentis gigantis mercurialis, in aere pendens, lente evanuit.

source: The Reboot was finished.
target: Renovatio peracta est.

source: Perched on a black wooden armchair, Loki abruptly thinned and shrank, transforming into a paper figurine.
target: Situs in sellā ligneā nigra, Loki subito tenuatus et contractus est, in effigiam chartaceam transformatus.

source: The paper figurine and chair then crumbled, disintegrating into dust.
target: Effigia chartacea et sella deinde corruerunt, in pulverem dissoluta.

source: Loki materialized in a far corner of the cathedral.
target: Loki in angulo remoto cathedralis apparuit.

source: Magician, appearing to still be airborne, quickly conjured an alternate self behind him.
target: Magus, adhuc in aere suspensus videbatur, celeriter alterum se post eum evocat.

source: As Loki reached into the void to pull out an assistant, his jet‑black eyes suddenly shifted to blue.
target: Dum Loki in vacuum se extendebat ut adiutorem extraheretur, oculi eius, nigri impiger, repente in caeruleum mutaverunt.

source: The blue rapidly stained black, then reverted to blue, the two colors continually alternating.
target: Caeruleum celeriter in nigrum conversum, deinde iterum in caeruleum revertit, et hi duo colores continue alternabantur.

source: Loki was paralyzed, unable to summon an aide, allowing Magician to stretch out her right hand and grasp with all her might.
target: Loki paralyticus erat, adiutorem evocare non valens, sinens Magae dextram manum extendere atque omni viribus prehendere.

source: The dark void warped, swallowing Loki.
target: Vacuum obscurum deformatum est, et Loki devoratus est.

source: Then, the two shattered into fragments, ultimately buried in a bottomless abyss.
target: Deinde ambo in fragmenta discrassata sunt, postremo in abyssum sine fundo sepeliti.

source: Throughout this, Loki’s body instantly became ethereal, unreal, as if he were a projection or puppet that had been swapped at some moment.
target: Per hoc, corpus Loki statim factum est aethereum et irreale, quasi esset proiectionem aut marionettam, quae aliquando commutata fuerit.

source: Hermit, Judgment, and Magician simultaneously heard a regretful sigh and witnessed the shadowy cathedral itself turn ethereal and slowly disintegrate.
target: Eremita, Iudicium, et Maga simul suspirium maerorem audiverunt atque ipsam cathedral umbratam in aethereum vertere et lente dissolvi conspexerunt.

source: It, too, seemed to be a projection.
target: Ea quoque videbatur esse proiectionis.

source: An aged, ethereal voice then echoed from the distance.
target: Vox antiqua, aetherea, ex longinquo resonavit.

source: “My wish is for all the demigods present to be lost for three minutes.”
target: “Desiderium meum est, ut omnes semidei praesentes per tres minuta amittantur.”

source: The shadowy cathedral fully collapsed, and darkness engulfed the surroundings, devoid of starlight or boundaries.
target: Cathedral umbrata prorsus corruit, et tenebrae circumiecta obvolutae sunt, carentes luce stellari aut finibus.

source: In the special mirror world, realizing Mr. K could no longer maintain his godhood‑enhanced half‑giant state and Overseer Perle was close to returning to her human form, Lumian’s first instinct was to shape‑shift into a shadow being and flee through the growing rift in the mirror world to find other allies.
target: In mundo speculi speciali, animadvertens Dominum K statum semi‑gigantis divinitate auctum amplius tenere non posse et Supervisorem Perle paene ad formam humanam rediens esse, primus instinctus Lumiani fuit se in ens umbratile converti et per fissuram crescentem mundi speculi fugere, ut alios socios inveniendos haberet.

source: However, he was unsure if Mr. K had employed any mystical items upon entry, and whether Shadow Transformation alone would allow passage through the mirror world’s fissure.
target: Tamen incertus erat an Dominus K ullam rem mysticam ad initium usus fuerit, et an sola umbratilis transformatiō transitum per fissuram mundi speculi permitteret.

source: As Lumian watched Overseer Perle’s face gradually come into view, her eyes and nostrils both vertically misaligned, a sudden realization struck him.
target: Dum Lumian faciem Supervisōris Perle paulatim in conspectum veniens aspiciebat, oculi et nares eius verticaliter disiuncti, subito intellexit.

source: I, too, can wound an Overseer…
target: Ego quoque possum Supervisorem vulnerare…

source: If Mr. K can do it, so can I!
target: Si Dominus K id efficere potest, ita et ego possum!

source: My fate is intertwined with Termiboros.
target: Fatum meum cum Termiboros implicatum est.

source: To a degree, we can be considered one.
target: Ad aliquod modum unum haberi possumus.

source: I’ve long known I possess a fake angelic level!
target: Diu scivi me gradum angelicum falsum possidēre!

source: The powers and items I wield won’t hold godhood and can’t touch an Overseer, but I should be able to do it myself.
target: Virtutes et res quas gero, deitatem non retinebunt neque Supervisorem tangere poterunt; sed credo me ipse id efficere posse.

source: I will become my own weapon!
target: Meum telum ipse fiam!

source: These thoughts raced through Lumian’s mind as a slightly manic grin spread across his face.
target: Haec cogitationes per mentem Lumiani celeriter percurrērunt, dum levis risus manic diffunderetur per faciem eius.

source: His blood seemed to boil, as if set aflame.
target: Sanguis eius quasi ebullīret, velut igni accensus esset.

source: In a flash, he disappeared and reappeared before Overseer Perle.
target: In momento fulgenti, evanuit atque ante Supervisorem Perle iterum apparuit.

source: His eyes had already taken on an iron‑black tint, revealing a few pale spots that marked Perle’s vulnerabilities.
target: Oculi eius iam coloris ferrei nigri ceperant, ostendentes pauca macula pallida, quae vulnerabilitates Perle designabant.

source: One such spot was just below the left side of her face!
target: Una talis macula erat prope sub latere sinistro faciei eius!

source: Before Perle’s shadows could fully reconstruct the Overseer, a multitude of incandescent white flames burst forth from Lumian’s body.
target: Priusquam umbræ Perle plene Supervisorem recomponerent, multitūdo flammarum albarum incandentium ex corpore Lumiani erupit.

source: Like a rushing current, they poured out from Lumian’s eyes, ears, nostrils, mouth, skin, and pores, completely enveloping him, transforming him into a raging inferno.
target: Velut unda impetuosa, ex oculis, auribus, naribus, ore, cute, et poris Lumiani effluentes, eum totum involverunt, transformantes in furibundum ignem.

source: Let’s do this!
target: Agāmus hoc!

source: Let us burn as one!
target: Nos una incendeāmus!

source: Let us explode together!
target: Nos simul erumpāmus!

source: Lumian, now one with the blazing white flames, swung his right fist at Perle’s left cheek.
target: Lumian, iam unum cum flammis albis flagrantibus factus, dextro pugno suo in gena sinistra Perle percussit.

source: Perle’s vertically‑misaligned eyes betrayed a flicker of confusion before understanding dawned.
target: Oculi Perle, verticaliter disiuncti, parvam scintillam confusionis prodiderunt, antequam intellegentia apparuerit.

source: But it was too late for her to protest or react.
target: Sed iam sero erat ut neque protestaret neque responderet.

source: She had not even fully returned.
target: Redierat enim non omnino.

source: Bang!
target: Pum!

source: Lumian’s right fist collided with Perle’s left cheek, caving it in.
target: Pugnum dextro Lumiani cum gena sinistra Perle collidens, eam concavato effingens, percussit.

source: As he struck, a ghastly wound appeared on his own chest and abdomen, but it was quickly consumed by the blazing white flames.
target: Dum percutiebat, vulnus terribile in pectore atque abdomine eius apparuit, sed celeriter a flammis albis ardentibus devoratum est.

source: Perle felt the pain, but it was not a mortal blow.
target: Perle dolorem sensit, sed non fuit ictus mortiferus.

source: At that instant, Lumian’s face, wreathed in blazing white flames, displayed a sinister and frenzied smile.
target: Illo instante, facies Lumiani in flammis albis ardentibus involuta, risum sinistrum et insanum ostendit.

source: It actually works!
target: Revera operatur!

source: I can truly use myself as a weapon to strike an Overseer!
target: Vere me uti possum ut telum ad Supervisorem percutiendum!

source: Boom!
target: Boom!

source: He detonated his right arm, using the incandescent white flames he had pre‑injected to make it explode.
target: Dextrum brachium suum detonavit, utens flammis albis incandescens, quas antea imposuerat ad id explodendum.

source: His right fist, propelled by a fierce, blazing white wave of flames, pierced Perle’s left cheek and penetrated her skull.
target: Pugnus dextro eius, ab fluctū albis ignis ferociter impulsus, gena sinistra Perle transfixit et cranium eius penetravit.

source: Cull!
target: Cull!

source: Crack! The special mirror world, with its dark barrier and numerous cracks, let out a shattering sound.
target: Crepitus! Mundus speculi specialis, cum obscura barriera et plurimis fissuris, sonum percussivum edidit.

source: It rapidly disintegrated and fell apart.
target: Celeriter dissolutus est et corruit.

source: Lumian’s head took an invisible blow, his skull caving in and teeth falling out.
target: Caput Lumiani per ictum invisibilem affectum est, calvaria eius inruens et dentes eius ceciderunt.

source: Deprived of his right arm, he was hurled through the air, his entire body wreathed in blazing white flames.
target: Dextro brachio carens, per aerem iactatus est, totum corpus eius in flammis albis ardentibus involutum.

source: His face twisted in agony, yet his eyes shone with elation.
target: Facies eius in dolore contorta erat, sed oculi eius exsultatione fulgebant.

source: Success!
target: Successus!

source: He beheld a horrific, blood‑red wound on the left side of Overseer Perle’s face.
target: Vidit vulnus horribile, rubro‑sanguineum, in latere sinistro faciei Supervisōris Perle.

source: Within the wound, a pale‑white fog intermingled with the grayish‑white brain.
target: In vulnere, nebula alba pallida cum cerebro cinereo‑albo intermixta erat.

source: The shattered fist had ripped it asunder and set it ablaze.
target: Pugnus fractus illud discerpsit et incendit.

source: As the blazing white flames faded, Overseer Perle’s remaining right eye dulled, and her body slowly crumpled.
target: Dum flammae albae ardentes evanuerunt, oculus dextro residuus Supervisōris Perle opacus factus est, et corpus eius lente corruit.

source: The cage imprisoning Franca and Jenna quickly disintegrated.
target: Cavea, qua Franca et Jenna inclusae erant, celeriter dissoluta est.

source: Mr. K, observing this, nodded approvingly.
target: Dominus K, hoc observans, laetus annuit.

source: Lumian is like me!
target: Lumian similis mihi est!

source: The fighting style is quite alike!
target: Modus pugnae eius valde similis mihi est!

source: The only shortcoming is that he did not loudly praise the Lord during the final blow.
target: Unum defectum est quod in ictu finali Domini clamore non laudavit.

source: At the same time, Lumian’s head buzzed, and he nearly blacked out.
target: Simul, caput Lumiani fremitavit, et paene sensum amisit.

source: He collapsed to the ground, on the verge of losing consciousness.
target: In terram corruit, prope conscientiam amittens.

source: He managed to stay awake only because he had undergone significant digestion of the Reaper potion.
target: Vigilare potuit solum, quoniam ingentem digestionem potionis Reaper passus est.

source: It felt as if he had completed another massive cull by the ancient tomb during the Dream Festival.
target: Videbatur quasi alteram magnam caedem per antiquam sepulcrum in Festa Somniorum perfecisset.

source: Wh— Lumian was initially thrilled, but then he forced himself to stand, shocked and suspicious.
target: Hem— Lumian initio exhilaratus erat, sed deinde se ad statum coegit, attonitus et suspicāns.

source: He knew the digestion must have resulted from his Culling of Overseer Perle, but shouldn’t a demigod suffice for him to fully digest the Reaper potion?
target: Scivit digestionem ex caede Supervisōris Perle orta esse, sed num non sufficeret semideus ut potionem Reaper plene digereret?

source: Lumian extinguished the incandescent white flames burning within and without.
target: Lumian flammas albas incandescentes, interiores et exteriores, exstinxit.

source: With his left hand, he retrieved the healing agent and Lie earring obtained from Jebus from his Traveler’s Bag, all while examining Overseer Perle’s corpse.
target: Manu sinistra, agentem curativum atque monile “Lie” ab Jebus ex sacco Viatoris adeptum extraxit, dum corpus Supervisōris Perle inspiciebat.

source: Just then, the special mirror world completely collapsed, and they found themselves back in reality, inside the quarry cave with a fixed mirror world entrance.
target: Tandem, mundus speculi specialis prorsus corruit, atque iterum se in re invenērunt, intra speluncam fodinarum, cuius ingressus ad mundum speculi reparatus erat.

source: Next to the protruding rock where Perle had stood, there was no corpse or white fog to be seen.
target: Prope saxum eminentem, ubi Perle steterat, nec corpus nec nebula alba videbatur.

source: Lumian spotted an oil painting hanging on the corresponding rock wall.
target: Lumian deprehendit picturam oleosam suspensam in pariete saxorum conveniens.

source: The painting looked torn and ruined, but one could faintly discern that it had once portrayed a woman in a red dress.
target: Pictura lacerata et devastata videbatur, sed vix intueri poterat quod olim mulierem in veste rubra depinguisset.

source: Perle?
target: Perle?

source: We weren’t facing the true Overseer, but a painted figure she created using a Pixie pathway item?
target: Non verum Supervisorem oppugnabamus, sed figuram pictam, quam ipsa instrumento viae “Pixie Pathway” creaverat?

source: This oil painting grants the depicted demigod a short lifespan, but no freedom of movement?
target: Haec pictura oleosa demideo depingto brevem vitam tribuit, sed nullam libertatem motus concedit?

source: Is that why Perle never budged and always took the attacks head‑on?
target: Numquid ideo Perle numquam se movit et semper impetus directe sustinuit?

source: Amid his bewilderment, Lumian drank the healing agent Jebus had procured from the Great Mother’s followers to ensure he would survive past 6 a.m.
target: Inter sua stupefacta, Lumian agentem curativum a sectatoribus Magnae Matris a Jebus adeptum potavit, ut ultra horam sextam ante meridiem superesset.

source: At that moment, Perle’s smiling voice resonated from the depths of the shattered oil painting.
target: Illo momento, vox subridens Perle ex profundis picturae oleosae fractae resonavit.

source: “I didn’t anticipate my painting person failing.
target: “Non praevidi personam meam pictam deficere.

source: But no matter.
target: Sed nihil refert.

source: What’s important is that the vortex is about to manifest.
target: Id quod maximum est, est quod vortex mox manifestabitur.

source: It won’t be long before you’re officially consumed.
target: Non longum erit, antequam vere consumberis.”

source: “Everyone will be caught up in it…”
target: “Omnes in eo inclusi erunt…"

source: Perle’s voice gradually faded into the depths of the oil painting, thwarting Mr. K’s attempt to track her through teleportation.
target: Vox Perle paulatim in profundum picturae oleosae evanuit, frustrans conatum Domini K eam per teleportationem deprehendere.
